name: Furse Earthing Systems
shortDescription: ABB's Furse earthing range: earth electrodes, earthing conductors, clamps and bonding components for the earthing part of a lightning protection and earthing installation.
importNotes: ABB publishes Furse as a solution overview; no individual product, specification or price is exposed for this range.
No dealership, distribution or authorisation relationship with ABB or Furse is implied.
_classReason: ABB publishes Furse as a solution overview only: the page names this range but no individual product, model, specification or price for it. All 1,459 ABB low-voltage product pages were checked and none is an earthing, lightning or surge protection item, and the ABB Library API that holds the Furse part numbers requires signed credentials, which were not circumvented.
imageNote: Representative photograph of this product type. ABB publishes no accessible image for the Furse range itself.
